name: brewery_padulles2026
description: Generalized reference brewery: 12 process streams, loads per hectolitre of beer.
reference: Padullés et al. (2026), Energy Conversion and Management 357, 121292, Table 2.

provenance.source_T_C: published cold-utility temperature (Sec. 4.1); used for all sources, which bounds W from above
provenance.sink levels: published warm-water tank 18-82 °C (Fig. 14); HTHP at GCC maximum T* (assumed, consistent with COP 2)
provenance.basis: assumed: 1.0 million hl/year, within the published range of Table 1 (0.25-1.5 million hl/year); economics at 8000 h/year (published)

sources.prices: Eurostat, first half of 2025, Portugal industrial: electricity 13.2 and gas 5.5 EUR/100 kWh (as reported by ECO, 29 May 2026); consumption band and tax basis not stated
sources.boiler_efficiency: bound (1.0): no sourced value found; sensitivity at 0.85-0.95 reported
sources.grid_EF_kg_per_kWh: Electricity Maps, 'Grid in review 2025: Portugal', 117.2 g/kWh flow-traced
sources.co2_price_sensitivity_EUR_per_t: EUA Dec contract 82.40 EUR/t on 5 Oct 2026 (S&P Global Commodity Insights)
sources.heat_recovery_equipment: tank 520.8 m3 = 375 m3 x (1.0e6 / 720,000 hl/year), scaled from Padullés et al. (2026), Sec. 5.1
